# Thine Code Docs

> Official documentation for Thine Code — agentic coding with Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, and other LLM providers. Fork of Claude Code with multi-provider routing, API-key auth, and Agent SDK.

## Docs

- [Overview](en/overview.mdx): What Thine Code is and how it relates to Claude Code
- [Quickstart](en/quickstart.mdx): Install, configure a provider, run your first task
- [LLM providers](en/providers.mdx): Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Ollama
- [CLI reference](en/cli-reference.mdx): Commands and flags
- [Environment variables](en/env-vars.mdx): Provider and behavior env vars
- [Agent SDK overview](en/agent-sdk/overview.mdx): query(), sessions, subprocess runtime
- [What's new](en/whats-new.mdx): Parity with Claude Code weekly releases
- [Feature parity](en/whats-new/feature-parity.mdx): Audit matrix vs upstream
- [/goal command](en/goal.mdx): Completion conditions and auto-continue
- [MCP](en/mcp.mdx): Model Context Protocol integration
- [Plugins](en/plugins.mdx): --plugin-dir, --plugin-url, zip archives
- [Prompt caching](en/prompt-caching.mdx): Universal provider caching
- [Troubleshooting](en/troubleshooting.mdx): Common fixes

## Upstream reference

Claude Code documentation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview

Fetch the complete upstream index at: https://code.claude.com/docs/llms.txt
